jobs.description: This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. It s an interesting time to join us.   Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn t exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we re rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades.   That means there are interesting product  problems  to solve - not just features to deliver.   You ll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions.   Although this is a fixed-term role, it isn t a caretaker role. You ll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it.   How we work   We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty.   We don t expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions.   You ll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them.   You ll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting
